Customers were asked to complete the enclosed response form and return via fax to (262) 835-3330 or email to complaints2@merz.com.  For questions contact Merz at (262) 835-3300 ext. 2627.

labelReview.scope: RADIESSE without lidocaine; face/décolleté document separate from hand and RADIESSE+

findings.text: Intravascular injection can cause blindness, stroke or tissue necrosis. Severe allergies, component sensitivity and bleeding disorders exclude use.
Active local infection/inflammation requires deferral. Lip injection safety is not established and nodules have been reported; CaHA can be visible on imaging.
